name: steam_turbine_isentropic_efficiency
title: Steam turbine with isentropic efficiency (Cengel 7-104)
summary: 3 kg/s of steam at 8 MPa and 500 °C expands to 30 kPa in a turbine with an isentropic efficiency of 90 %. The source computes the power output. Textbook exercise Cengel 7-104, which also asks for the entropy generation.
